dct_title_s: Holy See (Vatican City State) : Railways (OpenStreetMap Export)
dct_description_sm: Railway lines and stations from OSM, tagged with `railway`. Includes rail lines, tram tracks, and stations. Useful for transport accessibility analysis and basemap context. OpenStreetMap is a free, collaborative world map built by volunteers. Completeness varies by region: urban areas are usually well-mapped, remote areas may be incomplete. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org) - OSM tags: [Key:railway](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:railway) - Part of many [exports grid on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot) by the [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/en/)
